summary: Form 6-K filed by Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (TGS) on May 5, 2026, reporting first-quarter 2026 earnings. The filing includes financial results (comprehensive income Ps. 159,981 million, earnings per share Ps. 212.53), shareholder structure (CIESA owns 53.83%), and regulatory updates on natural gas transportation contracts via ENARGAS Resolution No. 66/2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a routine earnings update with no special-situation event.
